title: UI风格#48 - Renaissance Portrait (文艺复兴肖像)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Portrait style When color palette Then features aged canvas, gold leaf, deep burgundy, umber

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Portrait style When layout Then ornate frames, classical compositions, museum walls

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Portrait style When UI elements Then gold frames, canvas textures, oil paint effects

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Portrait UI When functional Then includes gallery chat, master agents, portrait stats
